description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Twitch's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] apply a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Deadly Venom'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 6 times.
description.text: Innate: Twitch's basic attacks on-hit apply a stack of Deadly Venom for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 6 times.

description2.raw: '''Deadly Venom:''' For each stack, the target is dealt「 [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 (based on level) (+ 3% AP) true damage per second over the duration, 」「 [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] 6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / 30 (based on level) (+ 18% AP) '''total''' true damage over the duration, 」for a maximum of「 6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / 30 (based on level) (+ 18% AP) true damage with each tick. 」「 36 / 72 / 108 / 144 / 180 (based on level) (+ 108% AP) '''total''' true damage over the duration. 」This effect is considered a [[File:Poison icon.png|20px|link=Cassiopeia/LoL|An icon representing the keyword Poison]] [[:Cassiopeia/LoL|poison]].
description2.text: Deadly Venom: For each stack, the target is dealt「  1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 (based on level) (+ 3% AP) true damage per second over the duration, 」「  6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / 30 (based on level) (+ 18% AP) total true damage over the duration, 」for a maximum of「 6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / 30 (based on level) (+ 18% AP) true damage with each tick. 」「 36 / 72 / 108 / 144 / 180 (based on level) (+ 108% AP) total true damage over the duration. 」This effect is considered a poison.

notes.raw: * ''Deadly Venom'' deals [[File:Wit's End item.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Proc damage]] [[:Damage|proc]] [[File:Blaze.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent damage]] [[:Damage|damage over time]], and does not trigger [[File:Blackfire Torch item.png|20px|link=Ability effects|An icon representing the keyword Ability effects]] [[:Ability effects|spell effects]]. * The first 5 stacks on a target are indicated each by a small mark around them, while a target affected by the maximum stacks of 6 is indicated by a single large mark above them instead. * ''Deadly Venom'' does not affect [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. * [[File:Runaan's Hurricane item.png|20xpx|border|link=Runaan's Hurricane|An icon for the item Runaan's Hurricane]] [[Runaan's Hurricane|Runaan's Hurricane's]] [[Named item effect#Wind's Fury|Wind's Fury]] bolts are special-cased to generate one ''Deadly Venom'' stack per enemy hit.
notes.text:
Deadly Venom deals proc damage over time, and does not trigger spell effects.
The first 5 stacks on a target are indicated each by a small mark around them, while a target affected by the maximum stacks of 6 is indicated by a single large mark above them instead.
Deadly Venom does not affect structures.
Runaan's Hurricane's Wind's Fury bolts are special-cased to generate one Deadly Venom stack per enemy hit.
